cause: Review-producing instructions described human traceability fields without binding their output schema to the exact identifiers consumed by the closeout validator.
prevention: Ship independent-verification and runtime-adoption report templates that always emit canonical task_id and unit_id where applicable, and validate generated reports through the work-close contract.
summary: TASK-AR-652 additive audit reports were independently approved but work close rejected them because their frontmatter used parent_task_id rather than canonical task_id and unit_id linkage.
title: Make review artifacts directly consumable by work close
